verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing for an AI model and API platform to ship, so the axis applies. The pack shows no first-party DeepSeek CLI. It only documents using DeepSeek as a backend model inside third-party tools such as Claude Code or OpenCode, which is an adjacent integration, not DeepSeek's own CLI. The DeepSeek Harness preview is never described as a command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
